5a5266253a125008.md: No orders failed. 212 carts took longer than 2 s to price; the dashboard shows no drop in conversion.

items.text: When does the saved carts rollout start?
items.sub: Recommend 19 October: the plan is approved and the migration is ready.
items.detail: The table migration takes no lock on `carts`. Starting on 26 October leaves one week before the November sale freeze.

items.text: Release fulfilment-worker 2.8 with batched label printing
items.sub: Cuts label time per order from 4 s to 1 s; owner: fulfilment team.
items.verify: Labels per minute on the warehouse dashboard rise above 50.

items.text: Renew the PayCo client certificate before 20 October
items.sub: It expires on 24 October; an expired certificate stops card payments.
items.verify: `openssl x509 -enddate` on the new certificate shows 2027.
